name: Australia
scope: Birds Queensland Australian species names, AviList 2026 release 2. Includes external territories and unusual records, not just the nine AVES planning regions. Origin and population status are attached only on exact scientific-name matches to WLAB v4.3 (2023). V/R flags may refer to Queensland and are not national rarity claims.

sources.title: Birds Queensland, Australian bird species names
sources.usage: Factual names and source flags only. No copied descriptions, illustrations or page design.

sources.title: BirdLife Australia Working List of Australian Birds
sources.usage: Exact-match family and population/origin reference. National 2020 threat assessments are not imported as current global conservation status.
